name: BreakOut15
summary: This EA implements a breakout strategy that identifies price range boundaries over a configurable lookback period and enters trades when price breaks above the range high or below the range low. It uses a 15-minute timeframe as its primary operating window and manages positions with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. The strategy aims to capture momentum from range expansion after periods of consolidation.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了一个突破策略，通过可配置的回溯周期识别价格区间边界，当价格突破区间高点或低点时入场交易。它以15分钟周期为主要操作窗口，并使用固定止损和止盈水平管理仓位。该策略旨在捕捉盘整后区间扩张带来的动量行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于价格区间的突破交易，通过计算过去N根K线的最高价和最低价来确定交易区间。入场条件为：当收盘价突破区间上轨时做多，当收盘价跌破区间下轨时做空。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈设置，没有移动止损或追踪止盈机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或波动率动态调整仓位大小的功能。资金管理方面缺乏保护机制，没有最大回撤限制、没有连续亏损后的仓位缩减、也没有每日亏损限制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但在震荡市中容易遭受频繁假突破带来的连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is range breakout trading, identifying the trading range by calculating the highest high and lowest low over the past N bars. Entry conditions are: go long when the close price breaks above the range upper boundary, and go short when the close price breaks below the range lower boundary. Exit conditions rely on fixed pip-based stop-loss and take-profit settings, with no trailing stop or dynamic profit-taking mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size approach, lacking dynamic lot adjustment based on account balance or market volatility. Money management is deficient in protective measures, with no maximum drawdown limit, no position reduction after consecutive losses, and no daily loss cap. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, but it is vulnerable to frequent false breakouts causing consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets.

parameters.description_en: Lookback period for price range detection

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
使用止损止盈保护每笔交易的风险敞口
突破策略在趋势行情中能捕捉较大波段利润
参数化设计允许用户灵活调整区间周期和风险参数
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and verify
Uses stop-loss and take-profit to protect risk exposure on each trade
Breakout strategy can capture significant trending moves when markets trend
Parameterized design allows users to flexibly adjust range period and risk parameters
cons: 没有假突破过滤机制，震荡市中容易频繁止损
固定手数不考虑账户规模和波动率，资金管理粗糙
缺乏新K线检查，可能同一根K线内重复开仓
没有移动止损功能，盈利头寸可能大幅回吐
未考虑交易成本（点差和佣金）对突破策略的影响
cons_en: No false breakout filter mechanism, prone to frequent stop-outs in choppy markets
Fixed lot size ignores account size and volatility, crude money management
Lacks new bar check, potentially opening duplicate positions within the same bar
No trailing stop functionality, profitable positions may give back significant gains
Does not account for trading costs (spread and commission) impact on breakout strategy performance
improvements: 增加成交量或波动率过滤条件以减少假突破入场
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈和仓位计算
添加新K线检查和最大持仓数限制防止过度交易
improvements_en: Add volume or volatility filter conditions to reduce false breakout entries
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss, take-profit and position sizing
Add new bar check and maximum position limit to prevent overtrading

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致同一信号重复开仓放大风险
固定手数在不同账户规模下可能导致过度杠杆或仓位不足
震荡行情中假突破频繁触发会导致连续亏损累积
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause duplicate position opening on the same signal amplifying risk
Fixed lot size may lead to overleveraging or under-sizing depending on account size
Frequent false breakouts in ranging markets can lead to accumulated consecutive losses

The strategy aims to capture momentum from range expansion after periods of consolidation.
